data.headline: The Artificial Advantage Toolkit
data.sub: The exercises, prompts, roles and plans from the book, in files you can edit
data.image_alt: Cover of The Artificial Advantage Toolkit by Elvin Peters

paras: The book teaches you how to direct AI. The Toolkit is where you practise it, in order, on your own work.
You get the working files from the book, already typed out and ready to change:

items.name: 16 exercises from 10 chapters, each one run on your own work, with a record of what happened.
25 prompts for common work tasks, in 5 groups, plus a spreadsheet you can import into your own tools.
25 role statements for your AI, in 8 work areas, plus the formula for writing your own.
A 30-day plan, from your first real task to using AI every working day.
A 3-month plan, from habit to saved workflows you reuse.
A 12-job tool guide, so you look up the job and see which kind of tool fits.

paras: Everything comes as editable Word documents and plain text, ready to use.

The Toolkit works on its own. The exercises point to chapters in The Artificial Advantage if you want the reasoning behind them. The ebook sells on Amazon for $9.99, and The Artificial Advantage Bundle is $27: it includes the ebook and these Toolkit files, plus other guides.
